query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS perique_molecule_links (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  perique_compound_id INT NOT NULL,
  molecule_id INT NOT NULL,
  match_type VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'exact_name',
  confidence DECIMAL(3,2) DEFAULT 1.00,
  notes TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  UNIQUE KEY unique_link (perique_compound_id, molecule_id)
);
